subject: skill/workflow-tests/pin-production-precedence
claim: Never change production precedence to satisfy a test defect: where a production rule is intentional and pinned — the explicit `rag_params['emit_self']` opt-in outranking the `FINOPS_EMIT_SELF=0` suite disarm — the test must pin that precedence with a positive-control assertion rather than weaken it. In the live-KB leak fix the rule stayed untouched (`_finding_emit_enabled` still returns the explicit opt-in first, workflow_runner.py:1819-1839) and the test asserts the gate OPENS via a positive control (tests/test_world_model_gates.py:558-561); the defect was the unguarded test seam, not the production rule.
